"""Verify exact preparation receipts, native proofs, sources and local links."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
R=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
def ref(p):
 p=Path(p).absolute()
 with p.open('rb') as f:h=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
 return {'path':str(p),'sha256':h}
p=R/'docs/results/v184-wave-readout-preparation-v1.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text())
checks=0
for key in ['CPU_plan','CPU_result','admission_plan','admission_result','admission_CPU_inspection','training_plan','training_launch','training_audit_source']:
 b=d[key];assert ref(b['path'])=={k:b[k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
 assert json.loads(Path(b['path']).read_text())==b['contents'];checks+=1
for b in d['sources']:
 assert ref(b['path'])=={k:b[k] for k in ['path','sha256']} and Path(b['path']).read_text()==b['text'];checks+=1
for key in ['CPU_plan','admission_plan','training_plan']:
 plan=d[key]['contents']
 for path,digest in plan.get('frozen_files',{}).items():assert ref(path)['sha256']==digest;checks+=1
 for b in plan.get('sources',[]):assert ref(b['path'])=={k:b[k] for k in ['path','sha256']};checks+=1
cpu=d['CPU_result']['contents'];admit=d['admission_result']['contents'];inspection=d['admission_CPU_inspection']['contents']
assert cpu['native_values_checked']==12779520 and cpu['inherited_tensors_exact']==189 and cpu['old_module_forwards']==0
assert len(admit['parities'])==7 and all(x['initial_output_bit_exact'] for x in admit['parities'])
assert len([x for x in admit['parities'] if 'nonzero_head_values' in x])==6
assert len(admit['records'])==2 and all(x['parameter_gradient_coordinates']==316 and x['independent_nine_term_FP32_total_exact'] for x in admit['records'])
assert inspection['strict_CPU_raw_EMA_loads']==4 and inspection['inherited_tensor_comparisons']==756 and not inspection['CUDA_initialized']
assert d['training_plan']['contents']['CPU_initialization']['new_head_parameters']==316
for key in ['training_live_rejection','CPU_model_state_tests']:
 b=d[key];assert ref(b['path'])=={k:b[k] for k in ['path','sha256']} and Path(b['path']).read_text()==b['text'];checks+=1
docs=[R/x for x in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/phase-wave-readout.md','diary/2026-11-08-04-19-42-phase-wave-native-and-training.md']]
links=0
for path in docs:
 for target in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
  if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):continue
  assert (path.parent/target.split('#')[0]).resolve().is_file(),(path,target);links+=1
out=R/'docs/results/v184-wave-readout-preparation-verification-v1.json'
with out.open('x') as f:
 json.dump({'status':'pass-exact-readout-preparation-native-proofs-source-and-link-bindings-not-quality',
  'preparation':ref(p),'source':dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'exact_bindings_checked':checks,
  'native_CPU_values':12779520,'initial_CUDA_parities':7,'nonzero_CUDA_readout_comparisons':6,
  'new_head_gradient_coordinates':632,'strict_CPU_raw_EMA_loads':4,'document_links':links,
  'documents':{str(p):ref(p) for p in docs},'new_module_forwards':0,'new_sensor_noise_draws':0,
  'scope':'Integrity of actual preparation and launched experiment,not image-quality proof. Current guides may advance in later commits;this receipt preserves their historical bytes. No full training/quality completion claim.'},f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print('PASS',checks,'exact bindings,',links,'links,actual native proofs;quality unmeasured')
